items.title: Marsh CEO John Doyle on Navigating Global Risk, Cyber Threats and AI
items.summary: Marsh President and CEO John Doyle explains how businesses can treat resilience as a competitive advantage rather than a defensive strategy. Doyle explains the importance of scenario planning to navigate continuous disruption stemming from geopolitical volatility and complex supply chain dependencies.

items.title: Marsh CEO on How AI Will Fast-Track Early Careers
items.summary: Marsh President and CEO John Doyle says artificial intelligence is fundamentally changing the traditional career trajectory for young professionals. Speaking with The Wall Street Journal's Chip Cutter, Doyle explains how incoming "AI natives" will bypass years of entry-level data collection, allowing them to challenge legacy workflows and advance up the corporate pyramid at unprecedented speeds.
